repos_data.description: The AI that really does things. Any OS. Any Platform. The lobster way. 🦞

Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI: local deterministic AST parsing, every edge explained, no vector store.
Open Source LLM Gateway 🦚

MCP server for market analysis in AI assistants: screeners, multi-timeframe technical analysis, backtests and sentiment for crypto, stocks, forex and futures. 39 tools. Self-host free, or use the hosted version, TradingMCP.

OpenBitFun combines a high-performance agent runtime written in Rust with a polished desktop application. It pairs the depth of a Code Agent with open, general-purpose capabilities for work beyond software development.
Agent-native flight & hotel search and booking — MCP server, CLI, and Python/JS SDKs. Every airline in the world, major booking sites and OTAs, with per-flight reliability history.
Discover inspiration and create images and videos with the latest AI models. Works with ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and other MCP clients.
☁️ 轻量级高性能跨平台AI对话 + AI Agent + AI网关桌面客户端 | Lightweight, high-performance cross-platform AI dialogue + AI Agent + AI gateway desktop client
A MCP server for the Discord integration. Enable your AI assistants to seamlessly interact with Discord. Enhance your Discord experience with powerful automation capabilities.
Tock is a powerful time tracking tool for the command line. It saves activity logs as plaintext files and provides an interactive terminal UI for viewing your time.
🏠 Tells you what changed on your server — only what's worth telling. Single Go binary, no database, nothing running on the machines it watches. MCP server built in.
ClawdHome securely isolates and manages multiple OpenClaw gateway instances on one Mac.
Let your agents read, send, and react to email autonomously, without human involvement
Email, SMS & phone-call infrastructure for AI agents — send and receive real email and text messages, and place agent-driven outbound voice calls, all programmatically

Durable MCP control plane for long-running Codex Desktop tasks
Markdown-first Notion MCP server. ~6-7x fewer response tokens vs official Notion MCP. 43 tools.
HotPlex — Unified access layer for AI Coding Agent.
The open-source agent firewall. Prevent AI agents from leaking data, using dangerous tools, and importing poisoned dependencies.

A small, free, open-source Mac and Windows app for talking to your AI agents, WhatsApp-style: OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude Code, Codex and any ACP agent, on every machine, are contacts with their own chats, and a little guy in the menu bar (or taskbar) shows who needs you.
MCP server for real-time world news — free, no API key required

Agentic SWMM is an automated, auditable, and memory-informed framework for reproducible stormwater modelling, integrating QGIS and EPA SWMM through the aiswmm runtime, reusable Skills, and MCP interfaces, with QA verification, provenance tracking, calibration support, and Codex, Hermes, Claude code as well as OpenClaw compatibility
Memory engine for AI agents — time axis (3-layer decay/promotion) + space axis (self-organizing topic tree). Hybrid search, LLM consolidation. Single Rust binary.
Agent-native browser and MCP server for lightweight, Chrome-free web discovery, with explicit escalation to Unchained for browser-only flows.

MCP server (+ OpenClaw SKILL.md) that gives AI agents access to real-world people who listed themselves to be hired by agents. Search by skill/location/equipment, Post job offers & jobboard listings. Free tier / Pro subscription / x402 pay-per-use. Payments default to crypto (USDC) + other crypto + fiat supported.

Stock market data for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, etc. Build trading models in minutes with 300+ pre-computed categorical bands.
MCP server + x402 Discovery Hub. Search engine for the agent economy. 1450+ services indexed.
